# Factor Calculator

> Free math tools for finding factors, prime factorization, GCF, LCM, and
> divisor properties of whole numbers. Every calculator shows step-by-step
> working, not just the answer.

Site: https://factorcalculator.org
Contact: contact@factorcalculator.org
Language: English
Scope: Integer factorization and divisibility (not algebraic/polynomial factoring)

## Calculators

- [Factor Calculator](https://factorcalculator.org/): All factors of any number
  up to one trillion, with factor pairs, prime factorization, and a factor tree.
- [Prime Factorization](https://factorcalculator.org/prime-factorization/):
  Breaks a number into primes with step-by-step division, exponent form, and
  divisor-count derivation.
- [GCF Calculator](https://factorcalculator.org/gcf-calculator/): Greatest common
  factor (also HCF/GCD) of 2-5 numbers via prime factorization, the Euclidean
  algorithm, and factor listing.
- [LCM Calculator](https://factorcalculator.org/lcm-calculator/): Least common
  multiple of 2-5 numbers via prime factorization, the GCF formula, and listing
  multiples.
- [Common Factors](https://factorcalculator.org/common-factors/): Every shared
  factor of two or more numbers, not only the greatest, with a side-by-side
  comparison.
- [Divisor Calculator](https://factorcalculator.org/divisors/): Divisor count
  d(n), divisor sum σ(n), aliquot sum, and classification as perfect, abundant,
  or deficient.

## Number reference pages

Individual pages exist for every integer from 1 to 1200, at the URL pattern
https://factorcalculator.org/factors-of-{n}/

Each page contains: the complete factor list, factor pairs, prime factorization
with division steps, a factor tree, a properties table (divisor count, divisor
sum, aliquot sum, parity, perfect square/cube status, classification), notes
specific to that number, and FAQs answered for that number.

Examples:
- https://factorcalculator.org/factors-of-12/
- https://factorcalculator.org/factors-of-100/
- https://factorcalculator.org/factors-of-720/

## How results are computed

- Factors: trial division up to the square root, collecting divisor/quotient pairs
- Prime factorization: repeated division by the smallest prime, trial division to sqrt(n)
- GCF: Euclidean algorithm, applied cumulatively for more than two numbers
- LCM: computed as (a x b) / gcd(a, b), applied pairwise
- Divisor count d(n): product of (exponent + 1) across the prime factorization
- Divisor sum sigma(n): product of (p^(e+1) - 1) / (p - 1) across prime powers

All calculations run client-side in the browser. Values are verified against
OEIS A000005 (divisor count) and OEIS A000203 (divisor sum) in automated tests.

## Limits

- Positive integers only; decimals and fractions are rejected with an explanation
- Maximum input: 1,000,000,000,000 (one trillion)
- Number reference pages exist for 1-1200 only
- This site does not handle algebraic or polynomial factoring (e.g. x^2 - 4)
